Avoid at all costs
Mar 2025 • Couples
We have eaten at these restaurants in Singapore and they have been excellent but this was a very different experience. The maki were nothing like the menu photo and had hardly any avocado in them. The ebi tempura was barely warm , which for something that is deep fried it should be really hot, the gyoza the same , we felt they had been microwaved but told not and cooked fresh. The food was overall very disappointing, our mistake eating here when there are so many other good Japanese restaurants in Saigon.

A nice Japanese surprise
Mar 2024 • Couples
Reading the reviews on the site it is true that it was not engaging. As I was invited and for a rather special reason I went there. And the surprise was everything was perfect: the service but above all the dishes which were very fresh, essential in a Japanese restaurant, but also the choice. The decoration is a little dated but it's a chain of restaurants, the same everywhere.
It's worth the cost to awaken your Japanese taste buds.
